sections.label: The firm
sections.title: Two websites, <t>two jobs.</t>
sections.lede: This site is the expert: his record, his research, his testimony. Pettingill Analytics is the practice he founded and leads, with a team that carries work beyond his individual practice.

company.name: Pettingill Analytics
